rulings.ruling: OPERATOR_CHOICE_REQUIRED_BEFORE_PK-7; ONLY_ABI_AND_SCOPE_PRESERVING_ROUTE_ADMISSIBLE. Option (i) is a reviewable candidate, not approval. Retain both original Decide exports, all component interface units, exact SPARK_Mode-only mirror, positive/refusal/native-body obligations and source/project/library/header identity. Options (ii)/(iii) are inadmissible. No new core Off exception or proof credit.
rulings.evidence_required: Concrete component source/project/link closure; matching original symbols/profiles/layouts and native positive/refusal controls; exact mirror; all new component pins and raw source/library/header identity; independent actual GPT-6.1 packet review before applicable operator decision.

rulings.ruling: REPROVISION_UNDER_OPERATOR_CUSTODY_AT_DEPLOYMENT. Mismatch refusal is retained. Keeping the old library is only a deployment hold and gives no successor-service/integrated acceptance credit.
rulings.owner: operator at deployment; lead prepares matching identity evidence
rulings.evidence_required: Actually installed/loaded reviewed library tied to source/proof/control identity, protected native_sha256 and provisioning record under operator custody, mismatch refusal, applicable deployment/rollback authorization.

rulings.ruling: LEAD_OWNED_STRICT_OBLIGATION. ABI-confirming representation packets are conditionally design-admissible, individually reviewed after legal family movement and before PK-S. No waiver or relocation-as-resolution. A nonconfirming layout change is outside this design and cannot reduce the target even with operator approval.
rulings.owner: lead for confirming repair/proof; operator only for separately proposed material ABI change
rulings.evidence_required: Exact prior layout on all actual targets/scenarios; compiler representation output; installed-tool legality; unchanged scalar widths/conventions/record size/object size/alignment/positions/bits/array stride/padding/sentinels/ABI version; C/ctypes/library identity; complete strict proof without family representation warnings; independent ABI and actual GPT-6.1 packet reviews.

ownership_findings: The v3 packaging correctly separates D-13 and N-06 operator decisions from N-01 confirming-repair engineering. No additional item found that transfers a proof/domain/strict-warning obligation to operator discretion. Operator approval never waives the fixed target.
